verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Plaid has a documented Identity Verification API reference. One documented endpoint is /identity_verification/retry, and STATUS_UPDATED and STEP_UPDATED webhooks report session progress, so part of the lifecycle is API-drivable. Session status and risk results are otherwise shown as Dashboard views, not API reads, and no other lifecycle endpoints are evidenced. missing for 10: documented create-session endpoint, get/list status endpoint, retrieval of results and captured media via API, cancel or redact endpoints, and evidence that every lifecycle step is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, the whole verification lifecycle is drivable through the API — create a session, get its status, retrieve results and captured media, and cancel or redact it — with every step documented

citations.quote: /identity_verification/retry | Allow a user to retry an identity verification
For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
